lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured arrangement of high-intensity circular pixel clusters is visible, forming approximately five vertical columns and four horizontal rows on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot sequences, creating a visible grid-like pattern across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge extends from the upper branchial region across the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadowed trough on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance circular blobs is visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, partially affected by surface refraction.

other_distinctive_markers: Three commensal organisms (remoras) are visible attached to the ventral surface near the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
